name: Nineteen Riviera Lagoon
paymentPlan: 10% down payment at sales launch, 40% during construction, 50% upon handover
overview: Located in the prestigious District 11 of Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Nineteen Riviera Lagoon is a signature development by the esteemed Riviera Group. This exclusive gated community epitomizes opulent living, offering a lifestyle of unmatched elegance and sophistication. With just nineteen uniquely designed villas, it promises a serene and luxurious waterfront experience, perfect for families or discerning investors seeking a premium property in one of Dubai's most coveted districts.
